summary: Iteration 4: validated the P0 bug fix (DELETE /api/users/{id}) plus 4 new features — athlete email/contacto fields, simplified team-goals PDF, N/A progress explainer for athletes with 1 evaluation, and send-report-by-email dialog. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed. Frontend: 12/12 UI acceptance criteria passed end-to-end. NO real emails were sent.
passed: P0 BUG FIX — Delete user: created viewer via UI (create-user-btn) then deleted via delete-user-{id} + confirm-delete-user-{id} → row disappears + 'Utilizador apagado' toast + user removed from GET /api/users. Backend test also confirms DELETE returns 200.
P0 GUARDRAIL — DELETE /api/users/{admin_id} returns 400 with detail containing 'próprio' (Não pode apagar-se a si próprio).
Athlete email/contacto: PUT /api/athletes/{aid} accepts email + contacto and GET returns them persisted. UI: Edit dialog exposes data-testid=athlete-email and athlete-contacto inputs.
PDF Objetivos de Equipa: /objetivos-equipa → click download-team-goals-pdf triggers file download 'trofense_objetivos_equipa_2026-07-20.pdf' without errors.
Progress explainer: André Gomes (1 evaluation) profile tab-objetivos shows 'N/A' instead of 0/100% and explanatory text mentioning '1 avaliação registada'.

Send report dialog: send-report-btn is rendered in header for editor; click opens dialog with pre-filled athlete email, editable message textarea, and submit button. Dialog was CLOSED without submitting to avoid consuming email credits.
POST /api/athletes/{aid}/send-report is wired (accepts pdf_base64+recipient_email; returns 503 when EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY missing — expected without real integration key).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~803 LOC) — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules: routers/users.py, routers/athletes.py, routers/evaluations.py, routers/photos.py, routers/email.py. Not urgent but recommended before next feature.

SendReportDialog.jsx: 'send-report-message' textarea is populated with a default multiline template. Fine, but if the user leaves it as-is and the athlete's name isn't in the template, ensure the backend HTML template (which does inject athlete.nome in the greeting) is what's used. Currently backend HTML greeting overrides — OK.

AthleteIn model now has 12+ optional fields; input validation is minimal (no EmailStr on athlete.email or phone regex on contacto). Non-blocking but recommend upgrading email to EmailStr for consistency.

PUT /api/athletes/{aid} uses body.model_dump() with default None values — this OVERWRITES any fields the client didn't send back. UI currently sends the full form so it works, but consider using exclude_unset=True to make partial updates safe.

delete_user endpoint has no cascade — an editor could delete a user that has created evaluations/weighins; the created_by ids in evaluations become orphans. Not a bug per current UX (created_by_name shows '—') but worth documenting.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (new file — pytest regression suite for iteration 4)
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted 3 TEST_ viewers via API + 1 via UI (all cleaned up). Temporarily set 1 athlete's email/contacto (restored to null at the end). Final DB state matches baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 items from the review request are green. Testids that work: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn, user-name/email/password/role, create-user-btn, delete-user-{id}, confirm-delete-user-{id}, download-team-goals-pdf, tab-objetivos, athlete-email, athlete-contacto, edit-athlete-btn, send-report-btn, send-report-email, send-report-message, send-report-submit. Do NOT click send-report-submit unless EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is set (otherwise returns 503).
rca of the issue: P0 root cause: backend previously only exposed PATCH /api/users/{id} (toggle active). Frontend called DELETE which resulted in 404/405 → the trash-can icon appeared unresponsive. Fix: added DELETE /api/users/{user_id} endpoint (server.py:325-332) with a self-delete guard (400) and a not-found guard (404). Reproduction pre-fix: click trash icon on any user row → no change in table. Post-fix: row is removed immediately and toast confirms.
